description: Sales tax applies by service type tax class, never by free text. Rates come from DOR rate tables by service address; this file covers taxability only.

cases.work: interior and perimeter insect treatment of a house
cases.source: Not listed among taxable services in sources reviewed; confirm with DOR
Confirm with DOR before launch. Wisconsin taxes spraying of lawns, trees and shrubs as a landscaping service (DOR Publication 210), which may cover yard spraying.

cases.work: a taxable line billed to a Wisconsin government unit with an exemption certificate on file
cases.source: DOR Publication 210, exempt sales to governmental units

mixed_invoice_rule: Invoices with taxable and nontaxable work show each portion separately and tax only the taxable portion (DOR Publication 210, mixed transactions).
scope_note: Out of scope: lawn care, tree and shrub care, and other trades. Mosquito and tick yard spraying, termite and wildlife are in scope because pest companies sell them.
